disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV Major depressive disorder; clinical cohort comprising discovery (DIDA-MDD, N=1148) and validation (REST-meta-MDD, N=1276) datasets. Patients diagnosed by experienced psychiatrists based on DSM-IV criteria for MDD, without comorbidities with other psychiatric disorders or current substance use.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Patients received diagnoses from experienced psychiatrists based on the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders-IV (DSM-IV) criteria for MDD, without comorbidities with other psychiatric disorders or current substance use."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Two large multi-center datasets: (1) Discovery dataset — DIDA-MDD (Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group), 9 research sites, N=1148 MDD patients; (2) Validation dataset — REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD), 25 research sites, N=1276 MDD patients.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "This study included two extensive multi-center datasets comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 HCs sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium."

age.detail: Discovery (DIDA-MDD): N=1148, mean=33.83, SD=14.97 (from Supplementary Table S1; paper text erroneously reports ±22.17). Validation (REST-meta-MDD): N=1276, mean=36.23, SD=21.38 (paper text value; Supplementary Table S1 shows '213.78' which is a formatting artefact). Combined N=2424. Weighted mean = (1148×33.83 + 1276×36.23) / 2424 = 35.09 years. Pooled SD = sqrt(((1147×14.97²) + (1275×21.38²)) / 2422) = 18.62 years. Min/Max not reported.
